reason: The plugin is primarily a file-handling bridge: it uploads images and common documents, rewrites them as workspace paths, and enables downstream text-only DeepSeek workflows to consume them via image/document-aware tools. It is scoped to attachment conversion and model-facing routing, with evidence limited to its README and package metadata.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 插件，用于将图片和常见文档上传后转换为工作区路径，便于文本模型在后续流程中通过视觉或文件工具读取这些内容。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin that converts uploaded images and common documents into workspace paths so text-only model flows can consume them through vision or file tools.

capabilities: Converts uploaded image attachments and supported document formats into workspace file-path references for model tool routing.
Supports a defined set of image and document file types for upload handling.
Stores uploaded files under a workspace-local `.dsh-vision/uploads/` directory before they are referenced by models.
